# W3C Digital Network

> Practical digital services operated personally by JAKE. CAC registered in Nigeria (RC 9579098). Primary site: https://web3currency.online. WhatsApp is the digital office.

W3C Digital Network is not an exchange, broker, or investment platform. W3C DESK is a peer-to-peer crypto desk coordinated directly with JAKE.
